body:
binop_c_symbol() had every comparison except !=, which silently emitted invalid C ('=(a, b)') instead of failing at compile time. New regression test in test_emit.c. make test: 35+8+348 passed, 0 failed. Also adds weapon_mod.prn, the real mod this fix was found while building. commit 2bd6ae3.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix missing != operator in C emitter, add stdlib/papercraft/weapon_mod.prn
